title: Model picker storage paths
responsibility: Computes the picker state and provider catalog locations from environment overrides or the user’s Codex directory.

outputs.name: pickerPaths
outputs.type: { home: string; catalogs: { openai: string; claude: string; }; }
outputs.description: An object whose `home` is HARNESS_PICKER_HOME when that variable is set (even if empty), otherwise `join(root, 'harness', 'picker')`, and whose `catalogs.openai` and `catalogs.claude` are `join(root, 'models_cache.json')` and `join(root, 'harness-gateway', 'claude-models.json')`. The root is CODEX_HOME when that variable is set (even if empty, which makes the paths relative to the working directory), otherwise `join(homedir(), '.codex')`; the function only builds these strings, so it creates no directories, does not check that the paths exist, and reads none of these files.
